title: What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange Count
question:
What is the ratio of merged Unified School District schools in Orange County to merged Elementary School District schools?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Elementary School District refers to DOC = 52; Unified School District refers to DOC = 54.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_067 = 'Unified School District' AND XCL_045 = 'Orange' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN XCL_067 = 'Elementary School District' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE XCL_044 = 'Merged';
